g.text: SyncEngine.Merge: one item of a sync file
file item (Id = its SyncId in the file)
file item has no language fields,
copy the rest from the file,
source.AllowSave and a last synced copy
(the cached copy holds no edit made here)
SyncMerge: each field and language tab
from the side that changed it since the
last synced copy; changed on both sides:
(a local edit not written back yet)
LastChange, unknown fields from the file
new Template/Folder with a fresh app Id,
merge its children the same way
SyncChildren: remove items no longer in the file
insert new ones, move to the file's order
The folder root adopts the file root's LastChange and
read-only open re-serializes identically and doesn't
churn the shared file (OneDrive conflict copies).
Write-back: BuildFileTree writes items keyed by SyncId
(new local items get a fresh SyncId), root title "Root".
